tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Ground of every screen, behind panels. A cool steel grey biased toward the accent, never a pure neutral.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, dialogs, the app bar, menus. Where recorded data sits.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, evidence bodies, code and command chips, rule slots, the skipped and xfailed badges, the pinned-group header.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and quiet-control hover. Never a resting state.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, row dividers, the dotline baseline. Decorative only; a control's edge uses border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and segmented controls, and the dashed edge of a rule slot. At least 3:1 on page, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on page, every surface-*, accent-soft and every -soft tint. Also the pinned pin and the running cursor.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, node id directories and separators, counts, hints, placeholders. 4.5:1 on page, every surface-* and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Marks that are not text: an unpinned pin, icons beside muted text, the setup and teardown segments of a phase bar. 3:1 on the surfaces; never for words.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt means you can act on this: links, run ids, the primary button, the active tab and nav underline. It never marks an outcome or a state. As text, on page, every surface-* and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the current item in a menu. ink and accent read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (the primary button). Dark in the dark theme, because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline at a 2px offset on every interactive element. At least 6:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: passed
tokens.usage: Outcome passed: its glyph, its dotline dot, its count. Teal rather than green, so it parts from failed on the blue-orange axis every common colour-vision deficiency keeps. As text, on page, every surface-* and passed-soft.

tokens.name: passed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the passed badge. passed and ink read on it.

tokens.name: xfailed
tokens.usage: Outcome xfailed: an expected failure, which counts as passing. A quieter slate-teal; its badge sits on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: skipped
tokens.usage: Outcome skipped: neutral, because a skip asks for nothing. Its badge sits on surface-sunken; its dotline mark is a 1px dash on the baseline.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Outcome failed: a full-height dotline bar, its glyph and count. As text, on page, every surface-* and failed-soft.

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the failed badge and the danger notice. failed and ink read on it.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Outcome error: a problem outside the test body (setup, teardown, collection). Wine in light and pale rose in dark, lighter or darker than failed in both, and its dotline bar carries a notch.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the error badge. error and ink read on it.

tokens.name: xpassed
tokens.usage: Outcome xpassed: a test marked to fail that passed. Violet, a half-height bar: it asks to be looked at, less loudly than a failure.

tokens.name: xpassed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the xpassed badge. xpassed and ink read on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention that is not a test outcome: interrupted runs, a dirty working tree, truncated evidence, a run deleted within seven days. As text, on page, every surface-* and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning tags and the warning notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: System trouble and destructive actions: the danger button, the danger notice icon, a field error, a failed export. Shares the failed hue on purpose; it is never used for a test outcome.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill.

tokens.name: interrupted
tokens.usage: The square of an interrupted run in RunStatus.

tokens.name: abandoned
tokens.usage: The dashed ring of an abandoned run in RunStatus: no end recorded and no contact within the grace period.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Chivo, a variable grotesque, for everything a person reads as interface. Sentence case throughout; no italic is shipped.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: The page title, once per page: a project name or a run id.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Panel, plugin panel and dialog titles.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Runs join this project when their metadata says so.

styles.name: t-body-strong
styles.usage: The one fact a row or notice leads with.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, badges, tags. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: Started 38 min ago by Ana Ruiz
styles.usage: Hints, captions, secondary lines under a row's first line.

groups.name: Terminal
groups.note: Chivo Mono for anything pytest or git printed, or a person might paste into a terminal. Its figures are tabular; add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums where digits stack.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Node ids, shas, branches, metadata keys and values, run ids.

styles.name: t-code-small
styles.usage: Tracebacks, captured output, check details, command chips.

styles.name: t-code-strong
styles.usage: The function part of a node id; the count in a summary line.

styles.name: t-figure
styles.usage: Durations, counts and percentages in tables, right-aligned.

styles.name: t-metric
styles.usage: The one number that answers a page, at most one per view.

styles.name: t-wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the app bar, lowercase: it is the command people type.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Rows and controls take their heights from the size family.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its word; glyph to count in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a group; chip padding; dotline to its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gaps between columns of a run row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the page gutter below 900px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panels; the page gutter; between tabs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; between settings sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above a page's first section when it has no header.

radius.note: Square-shouldered, like a terminal. Round is reserved for status dots and user monograms.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Data marks: phase segments, the interrupted square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls, badges, tags, chips, rule slots, command chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, plugin panels, evidence blocks, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and user monograms only.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Only what floats gets one.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers: the project switcher's list.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs, over the scrim.

size.note: Fixed heights and widths the components share.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and slots inside rows and panel heads.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects everywhere else.

tokens.name: row-sm
tokens.usage: Dense side tables: metadata, vectors in a narrow column.

tokens.name: row-md
tokens.usage: Table rows.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The app bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest the page column grows.

tokens.name: side-column
tokens.usage: The right column of a detail page (.dl-split).

tokens.name: dotline-pitch
tokens.usage: One result in a dotline: a 3px mark and a 1px gap.

tokens.name: dotline-height
tokens.usage: A dotline's track: a failure's full height.
